EmailBackupHeader.title: EmailBackupHeader
EmailBackupHeader.description: Cloud backup metadata, profile, and application settings linked to the user's verified email account for recovery across app deletion or sign-out.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the backup owner

email.description: Normalized email address bound to this backup

appVersion.description: Application version when backup was created

checksum.description: SHA-256 hex digest verifying backup integrity

contactsCount.description: Total number of backed-up synced contacts

autoBackupOnExit.description: Whether automatic backup runs before sign-out and periodically

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial backup creation

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest backup update

BackupChunk.title: BackupChunk
BackupChunk.description: Structured backup chunk storing conversations, contacts, or conversation preferences under an owner's backup.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the backup owner

data.description: Native Firestore map containing structured records for recovery

checksum.description: SHA-256 integrity hash of this chunk

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest chunk update

/backups/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated email cloud backup header containing metadata, profile, and app preferences

/backups/{userId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Owner-isolated subcollection of structured chat, contact, and preference backup chunks
